module purpose: Instruction memory (IMEM) for the Neorv32 core: accepts bus requests on bus_req_i, indexes the internal ROM (when IMEM_INIT=true) or RAM (when IMEM_INIT=false), produces synchronous read data in rdata and drives the bus response bus_rsp_o (data, ack, err); synchronous to clk_i and reset by rstn_i.

use-case flows.value: A bus transaction is started by the bus strobe; bus_req_i.stb gates writes and initiates the read/ack path
Write to IMEM RAM bytes: when (bus_req_i.stb='1') and (bus_req_i.rw='1'), bus_req_i.data and bus_req_i.ben selectively update mem_ram_b0..mem_ram_b3 on the rising clock
Read from IMEM: memory (ROM mem_rom_c or RAM mem_ram_b*) is selected by addr/addr_ff into rdata (synchronously), and rdata is presented to the bus when rden is asserted
Acknowledge (bus_rsp_o.ack) is produced by the bus_feedback process (different behavior for ROM vs RAM builds) to report request completion
bus_rsp_o.data is driven from rdata when rden = '1', otherwise driven zero
bus response state is cleared on reset: rstn_i = '0' forces rden <= '0' and bus_rsp_o.ack <= '0'

conceptual assets.concept: Instruction fetch result that this block delivers to the bus (the 32-bit instruction word driven out)
conceptual assets.reasoning: The module presents the fetched instruction on its bus response port when the read-enable rden is asserted: rden is set by the bus feedback process (rden <= bus_req_i.stb and (not bus_req_i.rw)) (line 176) and the port is driven with rdata when (rden = '1') (line 185). The analyser records that the output is produced from rdata and gated by rden (PORT bus_rsp_o.field at RTL line 185: DERIVES_FROM rdata and GATED_BY rden). rdata itself is clocked and selected from either the compiled-in ROM (mem_rom_c(to_integer(addr)), e.g. line 81) or from RAM bytes mem_ram_b0..b3 (lines 128-131 or 159-162). Therefore the correctness (integrity) of the instruction delivered to the bus is established by the RTL: corrupting rdata, the address (addr/addr_ff), or the memory contents would change the instruction observed on the bus (evidence: lines 81,128-131,159-162,176,185 and the map records cited below).

conceptual assets.concept: Instruction memory contents (the stored program words held by IMEM: writable RAM bytes mem_ram_b0..b3 or compiled ROM contents)
conceptual assets.reasoning: When IMEM is instantiated as RAM (IMEM_INIT = false) the RTL writes bus_req_i.data into the byte-wide RAM elements on the rising clock under the write condition (if (bus_req_i.stb='1') and (bus_req_i.rw='1') and the respective bus_req_i.ben bit) (lines 114-126 for the default style; lines 143-155 for the alternative style). The map records mem_ram_b* as clocked stores (CLOCKED_BY clk_i) and shows they DERIVE_FROM bus_req_i.data and are GATED_BY the ben bits and the write condition. When IMEM_INIT = true the ROM mem_rom_c (compile-time constant) is selected into rdata (line 81). The program code therefore is realized by mem_ram_b0..b3 (RAM builds) and by mem_rom_c (ROM builds); their integrity is Established because rdata (and therefore the executed instruction) is selected from these storage points (lines 81,128-131,159-162 and the map records below). mem_rom_c is a compile-time constant (not a port or signal in the closed set) and so cannot be listed as a structural port/signal here; the map nevertheless records its use in rdata selection.

conceptual assets.concept: Bus acknowledge produced by IMEM (bus_rsp_o.ack) that reports request completion
conceptual assets.reasoning: The bus_feedback process computes and registers the response acknowledge: rden <= bus_req_i.stb and (not bus_req_i.rw) (line 176) and then assigns bus_rsp_o.ack depending on IMEM_INIT (ack <= bus_req_i.stb and (not bus_req_i.rw) when IMEM_INIT else ack <= bus_req_i.stb) (lines 177-181). The map records bus_rsp_o's ack field as CLOCKED_BY clk_i and RESET_BY rstn_i and shows the field is GATED_BY the request signals in the IMEM_INIT=true branch and COPIES bus_req_i.stb in the other (map records on bus_rsp_o.ack at lines 174,178,180). Because the bus protocol depends on ack, its correctness (integrity) is Established by these RTL assignments (lines 170-181 and map records cited).

conceptual assets.concept: Read-enable decision (rden) that gates when rdata is forwarded to bus_rsp_o.data
conceptual assets.reasoning: rden is registered and reset in bus_feedback: on reset rstn_i='0' rden <= '0' (line 173), otherwise rden <= bus_req_i.stb and (not bus_req_i.rw) on the rising clock (line 176). The map shows rden is CLOCKED_BY clk_i at that assignment and GATED_BY the request signals (map rden records at lines 173 and 176). rden then gates bus_rsp_o.data (bus_rsp_o.data is driven only when rden = '1', line 185 and map GATED_BY record). Therefore rden is an internal decision whose integrity and availability are Established by the RTL: an incorrect rden would deny or wrongly allow read data onto the bus (evidence: lines 173,176,185 and the map records below).
